section_summary.extract_value: This section reports exploratory and confirmatory factor analyses of the BAS in the current sample of Black women, finding that a unidimensional factor structure is most appropriate. The CFA provided adequate fit (χ2 = 185.02, df = 65, CFI = .94, SRMR = .05, RMSEA = .09), and factor loadings ranged from .42 to .91. The section does not label the study (e.g., 'Study 1') and provides no sample size, demographic percentages, BMI data, or recruitment/source details.
section_summary.evidence_source: A preliminary EFA was conducted to explore BAS factor structure in the current sample, and two factors emerged with eigenvalues greater than 1. The model provided an adequate fit to the data (χ2 = 185.02, df = 65, CFI = .94, SRMR = .05, RMSEA = .09). Thus, these results support the unidimensional nature of this measure among Black women.
